title: How to Save Tax in India for Salaried Employees (FY 2025-26)
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to help salaried individuals in India maximize their tax savings for the financial year 2025-26. Learn about all the deductions you can claim.
content:
The Indian income tax system offers several provisions for salaried employees to reduce their tax liability. Understanding and utilizing these deductions can significantly increase your take-home salary. This guide covers the most important tax-saving options available for the Financial Year 2025-26.

title: Old vs. New Tax Regime: Which is Better for You in 2026?
excerpt: Confused between the old and new tax regimes? This detailed comparison will help you make an informed decision based on your salary and investment habits.
content:
The choice between the old and new tax regimes is a critical financial decision. The new regime offers lower tax rates but forgoes most deductions, while the old regime has higher rates but allows you to claim deductions like HRA, LTA, and those under Section 80C.
